dict.string: NetScope scans your Downloads folder to detect malware, suspicious scripts, and executable files that may pose a security risk.
NetScope scans your Documents folder to detect threats and suspicious files that may pose a security risk.
NetScope scans your Desktop to detect threats and suspicious files that may pose a security risk.
NetScope can scan removable drives for malware and security threats.
NetScope uses notifications to alert you when a threat scan completes or a security issue is detected.
